heading: How to Make a Claim
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Tell us as soon as reasonably practicable, using the contact details in the schedule, and in any case within the policy period or the extended reporting period, as [[ref:env.obl.tell-us-about-claims-and-pollution-conditions]] sets out. If there is an imminent threat to human health or the environment, act to contain it first: emergency response costs are covered without our prior consent.
